about_the_game:
⚙️ Forge Ahead Into the Steam-Powered Skies

Welcome to the skies of Durdoon, where ancient Dwaren ingenuity collides with danger at every altitude. In this co-op airship rogue-lite management adventure, you and your crew must brave a fractured world from above, navigating a high-stakes cycle of delivery, exploration, and survival.

🛠️ Upgrade Your Ship. Shape Your Fate.

Every mission starts from scratch. Use Dwaren engineering to upgrade components of an airship powered by a detailed steam-pressure system. Your choices matter—from engine power output to a variety of buildable emplacements. Success depends on how well your crew works together... or how well you recover when things go wrong.

🧭 Choose Your Role. Live the Journey.

Each crew member plays a vital, unique part in keeping the ship afloat—and alive:

  • Captain – Pilots the ship, issue commands, and make the tough calls.

  • Engineer – Master the boiler, balance steam flow, and build vital systems.

  • Waywriter – Navigate the unknown, mark points of interest, and unlock upgrades.

  • Gunner – Maintain and man weapons using advanced targeting devices.

  • Miner – Manage cargo and descend to the surface to harvest resources on missions.

No role is passive. Every job has depth, every decision has weight.

🌄 Dynamic Missions in a Living World

Take on jobs from scattered Dwaren ports—simple deliveries, hazardous supply runs, artifact retrievals, and more. But every route is a gauntlet through Goblurk pirates, raiders, dragon-like beasts, and deadly weather. Discover ancient ruins, hideouts, and secrets hidden in the misty canyons of the Durdoon Ranges.

💰 Return or Be Forgotten

Complete your run and return your company's ship to port to claim your rewards—currency to unlock cosmetics, tools, and tech. But fail to return? If you lose your ship, you lose your loot, and your progress, remember each Airship is company property. Every run is a gamble. Every return is a victory.

📈 Progression That Honors Playstyle

Level up your chosen class through repeated missions to unlock unique perks and abilities. Enhance your preferred role, become a legend in your field, or switch it up each run for a fresh challenge.

🎖️ Key Features

  • Rogue-lite Co-op gameplay focused on coordination and creativity

  • Deep steam-pressure system for realistic ship management

  • Modular ship upgrades: build it your way, every time

  • Unique crew classes with distinct responsibilities

  • Dynamic mission generation with handcrafted lore locations

  • Risk-vs-reward return system with unlockable cosmetics and perks

Are you ready to conquer the skies—or will the mountains claim your bones?

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4460 or AMD FX 4300 or better
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 660 / AMD Radeon HD 7800 Series with 2 GB VRAM
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX®-compatible soundcard

short_description: Crew a Dwaren Airship through perilous peaks. Manage steam, fight sky pirates, mine, explore, and return home—or lose it all to the Durdoon Ranges.
